question: What exalted status belongs to a teacher who has mastered control?
premises: Such a teacher commands supreme reverence
Even the gods bow down to him
inference: A self-controlled teacher is worthy of homage even from the gods.
uncertainties: vaśī bhūto may imply control over senses or over others; context favors self-mastery
plain_english: Even the gods bow down to that teacher who has become fully self-controlled.
